svg.text: Gradient descent near a saddle: z = x² − y², start (1, 0.000001), step 0.1
Downhill along x, uphill along y. The ball rolls in, almost stops at the flat centre, then slides off along y.
Hessian at the centre: eigenvalues +2 and −2
x: curves up (+2), a valley: x shrinks ×0.8 per step
y: curves down (−2), a ridge: y grows ×1.2 per step
Around steps 30 to 40 the gradient is about 800× smaller than at the start: the ball looks stuck, but it is a saddle, not a minimum.
